To cut a long story short, the USA got home first thanks to a last leg effort from a runner who bore more than a passing resemblance to Steve Scott, with our 'A' team not too far behind.

Sam Debell and Peter Lloyd did the double in the boys' high jump and 800m, while James Drake and Alex Breeze also won both strings in the colts' 800m. Steve Scott, Andrew Hill and Duncan Thompson took care of business in the colts' sprints and relay.
